as_told.title: Lazar sees a wall go translucent

plain: Bob Lazar, who says he worked on alien craft in 1988 and 1989 at S-4, a secret site in Nevada, says he saw a wall inside one craft turn see-through and show three-dimensional symbols. He tells Michels this on two different episodes, both times in the same plain words: "I saw the wall become translucent." The second time he gives no place, date or symbols.
